verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only indirect lifecycle levers. Persistence is described as "the default", which implies it can be configured, and filesystem snapshots are auto-saved on stop. Users can set and extend sandbox timeouts, stop sandboxes from the dashboard, and choose a region per sandbox. None of this documents explicit data deletion or retention policies. Missing for 10: documented sandbox, snapshot and drive deletion APIs; configurable snapshot/data retention periods; a statement on how long stopped-sandbox data is kept; independent corroboration.
